data.title: 桃乐丝 · 旧照片的指尖
data.description: 她的房间，她坐在床边翻看一张旧照片，指尖悬在画面上方没有落下；千年等一回的真心瞬间——随后她把照片收进抽屉，恢复了向导的表情。
data.action: 她的房间，她坐在床边翻看一张旧照片，指尖悬在画面上方没有落下
data.promptProse: Dorothy sits at her bedroom's drawer unit holding an old photograph above her knees, one fingertip hovering without touching its surface. Her pale-rose cardigan and navy trousers stay ordinary as her practiced smile fades briefly, then returns when she puts the picture away. The medium portrait keeps drawer and bed edge together. Lamplight warms pink hair and worn paper, with deep drawer shadows holding the private keepsakes beyond view.
